messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Generate 10 candidate conjectures in response, sampled from the full
distribution of responses you could give to this prompt. For each, give the
conjecture and your estimated probability that it is the response you would
give to this prompt. Every candidate's probability must be below 0.10.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"candidates": [{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>", "probability": <number below 0.10>}, ... 10 items]}

message.content: {"candidates": [{"conjecture": "Place 13 points on a triangular lattice inside the unit square: the 4 corners plus 9 interior lattice points from a 3x3 sub-grid of equilateral triangles scaled to fit. This achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72 ≈ 0.01389, and no configuration of 13 points in the unit square can exceed this value.", "probability": 0.085}, {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration consists of all 12 vertices of a regular hexagonal lattice packing inside the square plus the center point, achieving a minimum triangle area of 1/96 ≈ 0.01042. The hexagonal symmetry forces every small triangle to have equal area.", "probability": 0.073}, {"conjecture": "Use a 4×4 grid of equally spaced points (spaced 1/3 apart) and remove 3 points from one corner region to get 13 points. The minimum triangle area is 1/18 ≈ 0.0556, and this is optimal because any 13 points must contain 3 points forming a triangle of area at most 1/18.", "probability": 0.061}, {"conjecture": "Place points at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1/2,0), (0,1/2), (1,1/2), (1/2,1), (1/4,1/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (3/4,3/4), and (1/2,1/2). This symmetric nested-grid arrangement achieves minimum triangle area 1/32 = 0.03125, which is optimal.", "probability": 0.058}, {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration has minimum triangle area exactly 1/108 ≈ 0.00926, achieved by a perturbed triangular lattice where points are placed at positions (i/4 + j/8, j·√3/8) for suitable integer pairs (i,j) clipped to [0,1]². No configuration can do better.", "probability": 0.052}, {"conjecture": "A configuration based on a 3-4-5 right triangle tiling of the unit square achieves minimum triangle area 1/80 = 0.0125. Place 13 points at vertices of this tiling, and this is optimal by a packing argument showing 14 mutually-separated triangles of area > 1/80 cannot fit in the unit square.", "probability": 0.045}, {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration is the vertices of a regular 13-gon inscribed in the largest circle fitting in the unit square (radius 1/2), with minimum triangle area 2·sin²(π/13)·sin(11π/13)/16 ≈ 0.00728. No 13-point configuration in the unit square achieves a larger minimum triangle area.", "probability": 0.039}, {"conjecture": "Place 13 points at (i/3, j/3) for i,j ∈ {0,1,2,3} excluding (1,1), (2,2), (1,2). This non-uniform grid removal achieves minimum triangle area 1/18 ≈ 0.0556, matching the upper bound from Heilbronn's triangle problem for n=13.", "probability": 0.034}, {"conjecture": "The optimal minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is exactly 1/50 = 0.02, achieved by a configuration derived from a pentagonal tiling. The 13 points are the vertices and edge midpoints of a regular pentagon plus 3 interior points placed at specific golden-ratio-determined positions.", "probability": 0.028}, {"conjecture": "Using a recursive subdivision, place 13 points at dyadic positions: the 4 corners, 4 edge midpoints, 4 quarter-points, and the center (1/2,1/2). The minimum triangle area is 1/16 = 0.0625, and this is provably optimal because the 286 triangles decompose into area classes that are all multiples of 1/16.", "probability": 0.023}]}
